name: rowreduce-codegen-from-intent
title: From-intent high-perf row-reduction codegen: backend GENERATES the proven kernel from intent (not hand-emit)
creator: kingdom
notes: CLOSED as SUPERSEDED. The MECHANISM here is a toy, not a compiler: recognize_row_reduction() pattern-matches 'this is rms_norm/softmax/layer_norm' in Python and dispatches to a bespoke string-emitter (rmsnorm_emit.py etc.); the launcher regex-parses the module. That is '完全是字符串匹配，而不是 lower' (string matching, not lowering) -- per-kernel recognizers, the opposite of a mature compiler. Replaced by task #1 (real C++ OpRewritePattern in lib/Intent/Transforms/ that lowers the GENERAL intent.reduce + map_* neighborhood to the block-cooperative scf.parallel nest; stock MLIR maps it to gpu.all_reduce -> sm_120a). Proof of maturity = the recognizers get DELETED. The hand-emit kernels are KEPT as the correctness/perf oracle, not the backend. The validated facts (parity vs real liger, bit-faithful ~1e-7, block-cooperative reduction lowers to sm_120a) carry forward as the oracle the C++-generated IR is checked against.
